usage: agentware graph cancel [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--node NODE]
                              [--handle HANDLE] [--host HOST] [--now NOW]
                              name

positional arguments:
  name                  graph name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --node NODE           cancel this node + its subtree (default: all nodes)
  --handle HANDLE       actor handle (optional)
  --host HOST           actor host (optional)
  --now NOW             inject the clock (ISO)
